set(SFML_BUILD_WINDOW OFF)
set(SFML_BUILD_GRAPHICS OFF)
set(SFML_BUILD_AUDIO OFF)
set(SFML_BUILD_FRAMEWORKS OFF)
set(SFML_USE_SYSTEM_DEPS OFF)
set(SFML_USE_SYSTEM_MBEDTLS ON)

set(CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_MBEDTLS TRUE)
set(MBEDTLS_FOUND TRUE)
set(MBEDTLS_LIBRARY MbedTLS::mbedtls)
set(MBEDX509_LIBRARY MbedTLS::mbedx509)
set(MBEDCRYPTO_LIBRARY MbedTLS::tfpsacrypto)
get_target_property(MBEDTLS_INCLUDE_DIR ${MBEDTLS_LIBRARY} INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)

set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)

add_subdirectory(SFML EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
dolphin_disable_warnings(sfml-system)
dolphin_disable_warnings(sfml-network)
target_compile_options(sfml-system PRIVATE -fexceptions)
target_compile_options(sfml-network PRIVATE -fexceptions)
